name: Stdev
description: This keyword will return the rolling standard deviation of the series selected of the particular instrument.
how_to_use_markdown:
This keyword will return the rolling standard deviation of the series selected of the particular instrument.

STDEV is generally used under position keyword

This keyword has 2 inputs, one is to select the series, other is to select the period which is the no. of previous values to consider or the sample

![Example](./images/img-1631881032.png)

The above condition will return the  standard deviation of the NIFTY 50 close series, considering the sample data of past 20 candles
